claims.sourceText: AFSWC TR-59-39 Vol I, title page and report page, DDC AD 425380, https://archive.org/details/DTIC_AD0425380
claims.text: The report is 'AFSWC-TR-59-39, TR 59-39 Vol I, A STUDY OF LUNAR RESEARCH FLIGHTS', issued by 'HEADQUARTERS AIR FORCE SPECIAL WEAPONS CENTER, AIR RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT COMMAND, KIRTLAND AIR FORCE BASE, NEW MEXICO', authored by L. Reiffel of the Armour Research Foundation, Illinois Institute of Technology, dated 19 June 1959, under Project Number 5776-57853 and Contract AF 29(601)-1164. Its title page marks the title '(Unclassified Title)'. The string 'A119' appears nowhere in the report.
